question: How do I search for something?

youtubeLink.caption: Plantour How Do I Search
youtubeLink.description: This video explains how do you search for something

items: Click the ☰ (sandwich) button in the toolbar to open the features menu.
Click Search in the menu. The Search page opens with an empty text box.
Type your search text in the box. Plantour searches instantly as you type — no need to press Enter.
Look at the count shown above the list to see how many results were found.
Browse the results. Each result shows the category (such as Item, Traveler, or Trip), the entity name, and a secondary description when available.
Click any result to navigate directly to that entity's page.
To return to the Search page, click ☰ and Search again, or use your browser's Back button. Your last search term is remembered and the same results appear right away.
sections.afterHtml: You can toggle search term highlighting using the Highlight On / Highlight Off option in the Search page actions menu.
